FactoryGuestMaterialRead.description:
Reads one page of a sealed material or a candidate output of the guest's OWN run (W4H-28).

A guest on `--network=none` can only learn bytes through its reverse frame, and an input port carries only a handle: `{ digest, mediaType, storage }` for a material, or the `{ artifactId, digest, encodedBytes }` reference a validator is handed. The frame names exactly that: the artifact id and the digest of the CONTENT the guest expects back. It names no tenant, project or run; the host reads those from the verified attempt, so a guest cannot address another run's bytes by asking. Pages are one bounded page each (`FACTORY_GUEST_MATERIAL_LIMITS.maxChunkBytes`), and a readable whole is at most `maxTotalBytes`, the same bound staging has.

digest.description: `sha256:` + 64 hex over the content the guest expects.
